title: Allow multi select in `ScriptEditorDebugger`

milestone.title: 4.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 4 release.

## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

- Closes https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/15197
- Alternative implementation to https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/121716

## Additional information

This PR lets users select multiple errors in the debugger window and copy them.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8908f210-8f13-4d4c-961a-824dc01ee934

- When multiple selections are active, `error_selected` is intentionally not emitted so as to not cause the script editor to jump around unexpectedly.
- If multiple lines under the same error are selected, the entire error will only be copied once to the clipboard.
  - I've thought about only copying the specific line, but this would be inconsistent with the previous, single-select behavior, where copying any error line would copy the entire error item it belongs to.
  - I've also thought about automatically selecting the entire error item when its child is selected but again this would be inconsistent visually with the previous behavior.

## Disclaimer
Work on this PR started yesterday and was developed independently from https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/121716, which happened to be targeting the same proposal. The other PR was authored by a new contributor who by current rules is not allowed to submit feature PRs so soon, so I figured that I might as well as submit my implementation in their stead.

(Evidently our implementations are very different)
